title: Task List Pattern
description: Multi-step service hub: phase banner, task list with statuses, and back navigation.

components.reason: Required while the service is in alpha/beta per the Service Standard
Return to the service start page
Sections with statuses; only startable tasks link

nesting: Canonical DOM order 1 → 2 → 3 below the h1 ('Your application')
validationOrder: Statuses maintained server-side as tasks complete
Only tasks that can start are links
Status conveyed by tag text, never colour alone
a11yNotes: Task link text is the task name — statuses are separate elements
Phase tag text must be readable by screen readers
agentPromptSequence: 1. Place the phase banner above the page content
2. Add the back link under the h1
3. Render the task list with server-derived statuses
